evidence.visual_evidence_rule_original: Both entity labels must be visible with their time scopes clearly shown: one day in 2014 for car and all of 2014 for plane.

requires: mark:Average death by car (one day in 2014) @ car

assertion.greater: Average death by car (one day in 2014) @ car

evidence.route_note: geometry requires the two marks to share a zero baseline; a truncated axis fails geometry but may still pass by label
evidence.visual_evidence_rule_original: The car data mark or area must visibly appear greater than the plane data mark or area.

requires: mark:Average death by car (one day in 2014) @ car
